prediction_scenario.statement: The analytical target is the recorded organisational PerformanceRating, evaluated as if prediction occurred before completion of the corresponding performance-evaluation decision, using only feature families permitted by each prespecified information policy.
prediction_scenario.supported_interpretation: Cross-sectional leakage- and governance-risk sensitivity under explicit assumptions about feature availability.
prediction_scenario.prohibited_interpretation: The dataset does not establish that retained features were actually observed before a real evaluation decision, that all leakage was eliminated, or that the models are prospectively deployable.

availability_vocabulary.plausibly_pre_existing_timestamp_unverif: Feature semantics suggest a value could pre-exist the decision, but the dataset contains no observation timestamp proving this.
availability_vocabulary.timing_uncertain: The measurement window may overlap the evaluation process and no feature timestamp is available.
availability_vocabulary.unknown_may_postdate_decision: The field may encode a decision or outcome completed after, or jointly with, the target process.
availability_vocabulary.not_applicable_identifier: Identifier availability is irrelevant because identifiers are prohibited predictors.
availability_vocabulary.unavailable_by_design_target: The target is unavailable by definition at the stated prediction point and is prohibited as a predictor.

policies.name: INFORMATION_RICH_DIAGNOSTIC
policies.interpretation: Information-rich comparator excluding only the identifier and target; it is not a leakage-controlled or prospective system.

policies.name: LEAKAGE_CONTROLLED
policies.interpretation: Removes the declared direct, temporal, and outcome-proximal high-risk fields while retaining sensitive and organisational context.

policies.name: GOVERNANCE_CONTROLLED
policies.interpretation: P1 plus removal of direct sensitive demographic fields; this is governance control, not leakage removal or fairness proof.

policies.name: PRIMARY_LEAKAGE_AWARE
policies.interpretation: P2 plus removal of direct department context. Timing-uncertain surveys and other proxy channels remain, so this is leakage-aware rather than leakage-free.

policies.name: STRICT_PROSPECTIVE
policies.interpretation: P3 plus removal of features whose measurement window is concurrent or otherwise timing-uncertain. Retained fields are only semantically plausible as pre-existing; actual timestamps remain unavailable.

policies.name: STRICT_PROXY
policies.interpretation: P4 plus removal of direct role, compensation, assignment, promotion, and manager-context proxy channels. Residual indirect proxy information may still remain.

features.relationship_to_target: No legitimate predictive construct; unique row identity can enable memorisation.

features.justification: Identifiers are unnecessary for the estimand and are excluded from every policy.

features.relationship_to_target: Potential demographic association; not leakage by itself.
features.source_evidence: Acquisition schema; no observation timestamp or authoritative complete data dictionary.
features.justification: Removed to isolate sensitive-feature governance; removal does not establish fairness.

features.relationship_to_target: Potential demographic association; not leakage by itself.
features.source_evidence: Acquisition schema; no observation timestamp or authoritative complete data dictionary.
features.justification: Removed to isolate sensitive-feature governance; binary coding does not imply complete gender representation.

features.relationship_to_target: General background predictor that may encode socioeconomic or demographic proxies.

features.semantic_description: Years recorded with the current manager.
features.relationship_to_target: Manager and team context that may encode rating practices.
features.source_evidence: Acquisition schema and feature name; manager assignment dates absent.
features.justification: Likely historical context but a direct organisational proxy; removed in P5.

features.relationship_to_target: Potential downstream employment outcome or jointly determined organisational status.
features.source_evidence: Acquisition schema and feature name; attrition/event timestamp absent.
features.justification: Excluded because event order relative to the performance decision cannot be verified.

features.semantic_description: Recorded ordinal organisational performance rating with observed labels 2, 3, and 4.
features.relationship_to_target: The prediction target itself.
features.source_evidence: Acquisition target profile and pinned workbook partial codebook; construct-generation process undocumented.
features.justification: Never permitted as a predictor; it is an organisational rating, not validated objective capability or productivity.

global_limitations: The INX file has no feature-observation timestamps, evaluation-period timestamps, or decision-completion timestamp.
The workbook provides a partial seven-field codebook and does not establish complete semantic or source authority.
P4 is a prospective-plausibility sensitivity, not verified prospective deployment evidence.
P5 removes declared strong organisational channels but cannot prove absence of residual proxy information.
No policy supports the claim that all leakage was eliminated.
